name: CoW
fix_description: Validate msg.sender by computing the expected Uniswap V3 pool address using CREATE2 (factory + token pair + fee), instead of trusting an address from the callback bytes parameter.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is essentially a single direct call into an exposed callback with attacker-controlled parameters, followed by unwrapping WETH and withdrawing funds. It is very short, requires minimal protocol-specific setup, and matches an obvious unsafe-callback / missing validation pattern that an experienced auditor could reproduce quickly.
